extracted.name: Easy Mini Chocolate Cookies
extracted.description: Easy and simple recipe 🥣 Can be done with a big bowl！！ Watch the video too: https://youtu.be/MFgO7Y3BGhk ▷ Daruma Cooking Happy Cooking:) #chocochip #cookie #afternoontea #snack
instruction_lines: ●Preparation: Butter wait to soften at room temperature. After the butter become soft, Add sugar and eggs into the bowl. Then, add the flour and stir well. For the details, watch the video too: https://youtu.be/MFgO7Y3BGhk
Add milk chocolate or chocolate beans． Roll the dough into small balls.

Finally put the chocolate beans evenly on top of the dough. *If using heat-resistant chocolate chips Will not melt after baking. Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Then bake at 170 degrees for 15-17 minutes You can eat it after cool down! Enjoy!!!!
